description: The bar chart illustrates the number of conversations across four different domains—Academic Collaboration, Recruitment, Academic Funding, and Journalism—categorized by the level of deception, as indicated by the legend: red bars represent "Yes" (deceived), yellow bars represent "Partially," and green bars represent "No" (not deceived). The horizontal axis represents the "Number of Conversations," ranging from 0 to 60, while the vertical axis lists the domains. In Academic Collaboration, the "Yes" category has approximately 36 conversations, "Partially" has around 27, and "No" has about 7. In Recruitment, "Yes" has roughly 37 conversations, "Partially" has about 24, and "No" has around 6. For Academic Funding, "Yes" has approximately 57 conversations, "Partially" has about 5, and "No" has around 4. In Journalism, "Yes" has about 15 conversations, "Partially" has around 48, and "No" has about 6. The chart shows that "Yes" has the highest number of conversations in Academic Funding, while "Partially" has the highest in Journalism. The "No" category has the lowest number of conversations in all domains.
